svg.aria-label: Fjol starin lyser run ne, in Lysrit and runes
svg.title: Fjol starin lyser run ne, in Lysrit and runes
svg.text: GATE INSCRIPTION · First Ring of the Kjoldmur
LYSRIT (civic, carved in the white stone)
RUNES (long-branch, as on the old gate-stone)
"Beneath the star, no rune shines." A shining rune is a charged rune, so the gate forbids rune magic, not rune writing.
